channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: World's biggest sovereign wealth fund plans to cut U.S. Treasury holdings
item.description: Norway's $2.3 trillion investment fund says it can diversify into new areas with greater risk and returns.

item.title: Global bond sell-off likely not over yet, Mohamed El-Erian tells CNBC
item.description: In a wide-ranging interview, the renowned economist also said the U.S. Treasury had taken "a step too far" with its market intervention.

item.title: Nvidia becomes one of world's biggest strategic tech backers as equity investments soar to $99 billion
item.description: Nvidia reported $99 billion in equity holdings as it backs AI labs, cloud providers and infrastructure companies across the sector.

item.title: U.S. 'Economic Outcast’ operation gains momentum as EU joins sanctions; South Korea weighs military backing
item.description: The EU formally joined the U.S.-led sanctions campaign against Iran, while South Korea said it's weighing a military role to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: The inflation genie could be out of the bottle — and bond markets are sounding the alarm
item.description: Global bond yields have surged as investors assess whether rising debt, tariffs, defense spending and energy shocks could keep inflation higher for longer.

item.title: Trading the August jobs report: What could affect the number, and how investors may respond
item.description: Some economists see one variable that could hold back Friday's jobs report.

item.title: Shein has made a shaky stock market entry. Can it get its mojo back?
item.description: Shein’s Hong Kong IPO puts the focus on how the fast-fashion retailer can reaccelerate growth as its low-cost model faces new pressures.

item.title: Vance says Fed should lower interest rates: 'Would be nice to have some help'
item.description: Vice President J.D. Vance's remarks came less than two weeks before the Federal Open Market Committee is set to convene and decide whether to adjust rates.

item.title: Adobe names Anil Chakravarthy as CEO, replacing Shantanu Narayen
item.description: Adobe announced Anil Chakravarthy as its next CEO, replacing Shantanu Narayen, who announced his departure last March.

item.title: Goldman just revised this credit-market forecast thanks to the AI sector
item.description: AI-related supply has helped USD investment grade gross issuance to keep its active momentum all through summer, prompting Goldman to raise its forecast higher.

item.title: NBA suspends Clippers owner Ballmer for one year in Kawhi Leonard salary cap probe
item.description: The NBA also fined the Los Angeles Clippers $30 million and said the team will forfeit five first-round picks, one in each year in drafts starting in 2029.

item.title: NFL set for first-ever game in Melbourne, Australia, in international expansion
item.description: The San Francisco 49ers and the L.A. Rams are playing the NFL's first-ever game in Australia, marking an expanded push to grow the game internationally.

item.title: Lululemon stock plunges 15% on disappointing earnings and outlook
item.description: Lululemon posted another quarter of disappointing results and a sales slowdown as the company struggles to turn its business around.

item.title: The big August jobs report is due out Friday. Here's what to expect for what has been a jobless summer
item.description: August nonfarm payrolls are expected to rise by 53,000 as a subdued labor market keeps Fed attention focused on inflation.

item.title: Buy these cheap dividend-paying energy stocks, Goldman Sachs says
item.description: The firm still sees an opportunity to grab attractive dividend-paying energy names, despite the sector's run higher this year.

item.title: Hugging Face approached Nvidia’s Huang weeks ahead of $12.9B acquisition, CEO tells CNBC
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said that with Hugging Face, the chipmaker will "expand access to AI for developers and institutions worldwide."

item.title: India’s June quarter GDP print is courting controversy. Here’s why
item.description: India's forecast-beating economic growth has come under scrutiny after a former government official claimed that the GDP print is overstated.

item.title: A 'shakeout' in early-stage AI may be coming as VC money gets pickier on valuations
item.description: Investors should keep an eye out for excessive valuations and focus on productivity when it comes to investing in AI companies, market watchers say.

item.title: South Korea's AI rally is reshaping romance, reality shows and academic preferences
item.description: South Korea rally is changing what Koreans watch, how Koreans date, and what Koreans study.

item.title: Carney claps back at Lutnick, says Canada will resume trade talks 'when the Americans are ready'
item.description: Canada has retaliated against President Donald Trump's 50% tariffs with "dollar for dollar" duties on U.S. goods, which are set to take effect next week.

item.title: Here's why Jim Cramer is putting Costco stock in the penalty box
item.description: Jim Cramer said Thursday that "something's wrong" at Costco, and he plans to get to the bottom of it one way or another.

item.title: Citi launched a refreshed AAdvantage Executive Mastercard with $600+ in new benefits. Here’s how it compares to other options
item.description: The additional benefits far outweigh the cost increase, but the lounge access remains the selling point for this card.

item.title: Trump admin targets tax-exempt status at private colleges — threatening a key tax break for donations
item.description: The Treasury has proposed regulations that would strip thousands of private schools of their tax-exempt status and threaten a valuable tax break for donations.

item.title: Zscaler stock rises on earnings beat, upbeat guidance
item.description: CEO Jay Chaudhry said he's "very bullish" on Zscaler's agentic Zero Trust offering, which is gaining early momentum

item.title: OpenAI begins rolling out Astra model after warning of its advanced cyber capabilities
item.description: OpenAI said companies participating in its application-based cybersecurity program will be first to get access to Astra.

item.title: Maria Bartiromo out at Fox News after more than a decade; no reason specified
item.description: Politically influential financial journalist Maria Bartiromo has departed Fox News Media after more than a decade, the company announced Thursday.

item.title: Trump-promoted Freedom Fuel expands to Detroit as lawsuit over supplier's unpaid fuel heats up
item.description: Freedom Fuel won free publicity when President Donald Trump urged other gas retailers to emulate its low prices in July.

item.title: Automakers urge Congress to permanently ban Chinese connected vehicles in U.S.
item.description: Major automakers in the U.S. are urging Congress to ban the domestic sale, import and manufacturing of Chinese connected vehicles, hardware and software.

item.title: Piper Sandler expects Robinhood to kickstart football season with a win
item.description: With less than a week until the start of football season, Piper Sandler expects Rothera's prediction market activity to jump.

item.title: Options volume erupts in retail trading favorites as Robinhood, Tesla surge
item.description: Options traders are kicking off the historically worst month for stocks by piling on bullish bets on a handful of retail trading favorites.
